scope: Historical F3 diagnosis, F3.1 engineering and F3.1-E real diagnostic comparison. Read-only; no models or index operations.

F3.stage_identity: F3 is shorthand for the F2 seven-comparison-failure read-only diagnosis, not a separately executed research experiment or a separate accepted production stage.
F3.first_observable_quality_risk_stage: worker_resolve_requirement for all seven; not proof of Policy causality
confirmed: Missing BLIP-2 FC/prepended-soft-prompt, OPT/FlanT5 and Flamingo cross-attention snippets existed in pinned corpus but not corresponding Worker observed ledger.
Original SynthesisInput and reports preserve the same Claims; no newly synthesized technical facts or forged Citation found in this diagnosis.
True 8.7%/54x performance text is irrelevant scope drift, not fabricated numeric facts.
Earlier paper_id and multiple-actions execution errors recovered and are not independently established causes of final semantic failures.
uncertain: Cross-paper wording may cause local-task drift, but causal attribution is untested.
Reviewer accepting peer facts/whole-paper absence cannot be attributed to hidden reasoning.
First/third/fourth/seventh strict binary labels have sensitivity issues; labels retained.
source_limitations: Reviewer input is deterministically reconstructed from recorded Worker and pinned corpus, not archived original request.
F2 did not archive full ToolObservation payload, retrieval scores/full TopK, or full Provider request-response.
Accumulated observed IDs and difference ledger do not recover complete TopK or ranking.
F3.git_status_warning: Original diagnostics remain pre-existing untracked files; preserve them. Portable committed authoritative source is F2 executions.jsonl.

F3_1.runtime: CoverageAwarePaperWorker inherits frozen PaperResearchWorker.run; explicit opt-in composition; default entrypoints untouched.
mechanism: Generic expected aspects for five dimensions; covered/missing/not_applicable.
Supported requires declared complete attributes/stages and observed same-paper identity-valid evidence; uncovered submission rejected with recoverable feedback.
Authoritative Claim is deterministically assembled from declared coverage facts; citations union passes parent validation.
Partially supported facts only diagnostic sidecar; unchanged official insufficiency has no Claim/citation.
Keeps model/tool budgets, shared RetryPolicy/ResourceGate, timeout/cancellation and existing status enum.
not_guaranteed: covered is a model semantic declaration; deterministic code does not prove entailment/completeness.
A correct subject_paper_id field does not independently exclude peer-paper text.
Unknown dimensions use generic requested_facts rather than semantic auto-classification.

F3_1_E.baseline: Read only saved F2 executions; never reran old Worker.
F3_1_E.treatment: Explicit CoverageAwarePaperWorker in initial/recovery factories; original Reviewer/Recovery/Synthesis; formal fixed configuration seven runs.

configuration.source_label_policy: Source-checked candidate labels; not independently human-approved exhaustive relevance labels.

semantic_quality.provenance: AI-assisted nonblind source-backed semantic adjudication, zero human assessments; original F2 false labels unchanged.

confounds: Known failure diagnostic subset, not unknown-data generalization.
Provider alias and stochastic responses may drift across dates; no underlying model weight revision is exposed.
F2 did not archive endpoint or embedding cache revision; same configured model/index are verified, hidden revisions cannot be compared.
Read-only instrumentation and a 420-second case watchdog are new; baseline had operation budgets but no archived case watchdog.
Same AI-assisted semantic review family, no blind independent human Gold assessment.

F2 wall_time_ms starts before runtime setup and is captured before final drain/close; Treatment is captured after drain/close and diagnostic collection, with some setup before its timer. These timing boundaries and server load differences prevent exact causal attribution of latency delta.
important_failures: Case2 language_interface=covered but no FC projection/prepended soft prompts delivered.

Case3 six coverage submissions fail top-level/stage schema, then malformed tool JSON triggers permanent parsing failure; source evidence existed; reject and preserve execution_failed, not a reasonable abstention.
Case4 losses=covered omits original LM/prefix-LM loss distinction and asserts text encoder optimization not demonstrated by cited evidence; not proof actual encoder update was false.
F3_1_E.score_revision: Case4 six-axis factual_accuracy 2→1; pre-revision AI review archived. Strict case remains false and aggregate4/7 unchanged.
